[SWS_DM_01051] DM behavior on transmission Mode stopSending without pe-
riodicDataIdentifier in the request
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04215
⌈
On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A) with transmis-
sionMode set to ’stopSending’ and no periodicDataIdentifier in the request, the DM
shall stop all scheduled periodicDataIdentifier transmissions.
⌋
